{{Recipe summary
| Category = Salmon recipes

}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 1 side (1.5–2 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) of sockeye [[Cookbook:Salmon|salmon]]
* [[Cookbook:Salmon|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] dark [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]]
* 1 large untreated maple plank, soaked in water for at least 1 hour

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] salmon with oil. Sprinkle liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
#Place salmon on plank. Heat [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] to medium on one burner.
#Bring rum to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over high heat. Remove from heat and ignite. Boil until reduced to ¼ cup.
#Place plank on indirect heat and cook for 20 minutes, brushing often with rum.
#Let rest 5 minutes. Serve.
